native_header_contract.policy: the formatter does not rewrite outreg2 model or dependent-variable headers

estimation_handoff: the caller restores any approved .ster states under readable estimate names; the formatter consumes the ordered names without assuming an outcome count, specification count, sample, estimator, or model role. A 2SLS second-stage estimate and its separately estimated first-stage can be passed together in one caller-declared sheet.

raw_output_contract.policy: preserve the complete native outreg2 coefficient and standard-error output without keep(), drop(), relabeling, or coefficient reconstruction
raw_output_contract.explicitly_excluded_reference_period: 2019 has no coefficient row because it is absent from the selected event levels
raw_output_contract.native_row_order: unchanged before the two explicitly assembled statistic rows and native note rows

source_table_contract: outreg2 produces the unfiltered native coefficient, standard-error, header, and note table; stored statistics are inserted separately after import
dependent_mean_attachment: Each of the three event-study estimates, the separately estimated first stage, the ivregress 2sls second stage, and the Poisson estimate ran estadd ysumm, mean after an independent e(sample) mean check. The fixture then asserted formatted e(ymean) values at six decimal places before saving each .ster.
claim_boundary: This verifies one estimator- and specification-count-neutral formatter on three synthetic clustered event-study estimates, a separately estimated first stage, a real ivregress 2sls second stage, and a clustered Poisson estimate. The caller can place the 2SLS and first-stage estimates together in one named sheet. It leaves native outreg2 headers, coefficient rows, standard-error rows, base and omitted forms, and notes unchanged; the single-# event RHS avoids ##-generated treatment main effects and #0b rows. The Poisson estimate has missing e(r2_a), and the formatter writes an empty Adjusted R-squared cell while retaining the raw Poisson row and its e(sample)-derived dependent-variable mean. No first-stage diagnostic row was added. The fixture confirms scratch cleanup and fixed readable widths.
